passages.text: Billbergia nutans, or Queen's-tears, is an epiphytic bromeliad native to Brazil, Paraguay, Uruguay, and Argentina.
This plant is often used as an ornamental plant.{{cn|date=March 2019}}

Billbergia nutans var. nutans – Brazil, Paraguay, Uruguay, and Argentina
Billbergia nutans var. schimperiana (Wittm. ex Baker) Mez – Brazil, Paraguay
